acceptanceCriteria: --shard-plan naming a FIFO is refused promptly with a typed error.
A test proves the refusal without blocking.
Regular plan files read as before.
body: Found by the V1-1579 repair lane (PR #1027, head ba1026b88). The shard input reads now use readBoundedFile (O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file check, bound+1 read), but ReadShardPlan via decodeStrictBounded still uses plain os.Open, so `--shard-plan` naming a FIFO blocks indefinitely. Expected: refuse non-regular files without blocking, as STR-V0-050 now requires for the other inputs.
title: corvint test --shard-plan: ReadShardPlan opens with plain os.Open, so a FIFO path blocks (V1-1579 residual)
